description_en: Creates or updates an end-to-end canary release swimlane group
description_zh: 用于创建或者更新全链路灰度泳道组
name: CreateOrUpdateSwimmingLaneGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the MSE namespace
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The ID of the swimlane group. A value of -1 indicates that a swimlane group is created. A value greater than 0 indicates that a specified swimlane group is updated
parameters.help_zh: 泳道组ID。-1时为创建泳道组，大于0时为修改指定泳道组
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the swimlane group
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the swimlane group. Valid values:
0: Inactive.
1: Active
parameters.help_zh: 取值为0表示未生效，取值为1表示生效
parameters.name: status
entry_app

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the applications. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 应用集合。以 "," 分割应用 id
parameters.name: app_ids

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable canary release for message queues
parameters.name: message_queue_gray_enable

parameters.help_en: The side where message queue canary release filtering is performed
parameters.name: message_queue_filter_side

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] Specifies whether to enable canary release for databases
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，是否开启数据库灰度
parameters.name: db_gray_enable

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to record request details
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启记录请求详情
parameters.name: record_canary_detail

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] The paths. This parameter is required when a Java gateway is used as the entry point
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃，java网关为入口时填写该参数
parameters.name: paths

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the routes. If a cloud-native gateway is used as the entry point, you must call this operation to pass the IDs of the selected cloud-native gateway routes before creating a swimlane for the swimlane group
parameters.help_zh: 路由ID列表（以云原生网关为入口时，在创建泳道组的泳道前，需调用本接口传入选择的云原生网关路由ID列表）
parameters.name: route_ids

parameters.help_en:
The end-to-end canary release mode. Valid values:
0: Route by request content.
1: Route by proportion
parameters.help_zh:
全链路灰度模式：

0: 按请求内容路由

1: 按比例路由
parameters.name: canary_model

parameters.help_en:
The version of the end-to-end canary release. Valid values:
0: Not recommended. Routes must be specified.
2: Recommended. Routes do not need to be specified
parameters.help_zh: 全链路灰度版本，取值范围：0（不推荐使用，需要指定路由）,2(推荐使用，无需指定路由)
parameters.name: swim_version

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
